payload.notes: Policy-compliant four-B70 record for the frozen 0xSero DeepSeek V4 Flash uniform-K160 checkpoint. Direct graph-captured native Xe2 MHC outputs remove persistent warmup-shape buffers, cutting peak activation memory from 2.93 to 1.30 GiB per GPU and raising KV capacity from roughly 1.9K to 6,508 tokens. The non-speculative lane also skips the otherwise unused pre-head MTP state copy. The fixed cold suite improved from 10.09033 to 10.11537 median tok/s (+0.25%); all 12 unique prompts reported cached_tokens=0, and arithmetic, exact-copy, Paris, and strict-JSON canaries passed. No speculation or reuse. K160 remains an experimental hash-pruned smoke/performance artifact, not an official-source quality-certified final pack.
